question_or_symptom: A transport-open provider handle can be mistaken for an opened KFD channel or discovered GPU topology.
observation: sagr_provider_query_lifecycle reports only a valid handle after the established host transport handshake. It performs no hsaKmtOpenKFD, topology, DRM, or device-node operation; KERNEL_IO_CHANNEL_NOT_OPENED is reserved for a future full-provider KFD policy.
conclusion: Transport session state and KFD lifecycle state need distinct APIs and status contracts.
decision: Keep the current query explicitly transport-open and defer KFD/topology success statuses until a typed daemon operation envelope and no-device audit exist.
invalidated_assumptions: A successful provider_open implies hsaKmtOpenKFD success.
KERNEL_IO_CHANNEL_NOT_OPENED is the result of the current transport lifecycle query.
